French Catholic Church of the Assumption
Built in 1859, it occasionally hosts concerts but is otherwise only open for mass.

This mansion was built in 1900 for British businessman William Whittall, but it's best known as the home of rock star Barış Manço (1943-1999). He lived here from 1984 and it's now a museum of his life and work.
They play soccer in Süper Lig, the top tier, and routinely qualify for European tournaments. There's also a museum of the club, which fields teams in several other sports such as basketball.
